Formatting note: adding everything in one email so the thread is handy for calendar + audit.

Agenda locked for 75 minutes as proposed. I created a Google Calendar invite and added the roster above. If anyone needs the invite forwarded to additional attendees, reply-all and we'll update.

Quick answers for your security team (short bullets we can expand during the call):
- Audit logs: request/response logs (token-level), request metadata (client id, route, model version), and operation-level events (deploy, rollback) retained per-customer — default 90 days (can be extended on Dedicated/Private).
- Access controls: role-based access via SSO (SCIM), per-route API keys, and optional HSM-backed key management for customer keys.
- Data handling: no customer prompts used for training by default; KV cache eviction is configurable; encrypted at-rest (AES-256) and in-transit (TLS1.3).
- Compliance: SOC2 Type II report available under NDA; we can provide SOC artifacts during procurement.

Prep items for ClearLens (if you can share ahead):
- Representative payloads or qps samples (anonymized is fine)
- Typical sequence lengths and peak concurrent streams

I'll attach the calendar invite shortly (Google will send it automatically) and also place the pre-read in the shared Drive folder. Looking forward to the runthrough.

Thanks — Mark, Neha & Dylan
